name: Mind the Gap
source:
A journey without destination.
A story you can’t escape.


You wake up in a train compartment you don’t remember boarding. The air feels too heavy, the silence too deliberate. Outside your door you hear voices, footsteps, strangers who look just as lost as you. The train keeps moving, but no one knows where.

[From [url=https://sweepix.itch.io/mind-the-gap]itch.io[/url]]
